verbetes.glosa_atual: separação; consagração de oferenda; afastamento por impureza.
definicoes_originais: separation, setting apart for a sacred purpose, as the heave-offering (T’rumah, for the priest), or a sacrifice (Korban); also isolation on account of levitical uncleanness, or on acc.
crossing the Ocean; cmp. פָּרַשׁ.
notas_originais: of sacredness. Trnsf. the thing set apart, offering, gift. Y. Yoma I, beg. 38 a; Tosef. Parah III (II), 1 זה (הַ)אַפְרָשָׁתוֹ בטהרה וכ' (Babli Yoma 8 b פרישתו) the one is isolated for the purpose of purification (because of uncleanness), the other for sanctification (for the services of the Day of Atonement). Y. Dem. VII, 26 b bot. תלוי בה' depends on the act of setting apart. B. Kam. V, 7 הַפְרָשַׁת הר סיני the isolation of Mount Sinai prescribed as preparation for the giving of the Law (Ex. XIX, 13); a. fr.— Pl. אַפְרָשׁוֹת, הַפְרָשׁוֹת. Y. Shek. II, 46 d top שלש א' three kinds of sacred gifts.
Gen. R. s. 6 הפרשת וכ'; Lev. R. s. 25 פָּרָשַׁת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: dedo, especialmente indicador; projeção em forma de dedo.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.; = עצבע; עצב, √צב, cmp. Job X, 8; cmp. טבע a. טבעת)
finger, esp. index-finger.
any projecting limb resembling the shape of a finger.
notas_originais: Men. 11 a זו א' with this (the fourth from the little finger) the measure of ‘a finger’ is taken; Keth. 5 b. Y. Taan. IV, 68 d bot.; Lam. R. to II, 2 (מטיפי) מקוטעי א' who had their finger cut off (in evidence of devotion to the cause). Yoma I, 7 א' צרדה; Tosef. ib. 9 explained א' גדולה middle finger; cmp. Tanḥ. Bo, end, expl. אמצעית.—Keth. 71 a הוא נותן א' וכ' he (the husband) puts his finger between her teeth (and must expect to be bitten), i.e. has to take the consequences of not interfering with her vow in due time.

Ḥull. 61 a א' יתירה the projecting toe on a bird’s claw. Tam. IV, 3 (31 a) א' הכבד the lobe of the liver.—Fig. (like יד) share, part. Y. Pes. IV, 31 a top; Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40 a top, v. אֶמְצַע.— Pl. אֶצְבָּעוֹת. Ḥag. 15 a; a. fr. (mostly in the sense of finger’s length).—Pes. 112 b; Nidd. 66 a euphem. for membra virilia.— Dual אֶצְבְּעַיִּם, אֶצְבְּעַיִּים, Cant. R. to VIII, 11 גידם א' one whose (index) fingers were lopped (stump-like). Ib. that whole trade of mine אינה נקנית אלא בא' cannot be acquired except by learning how to use the index-fingers.—Pes. 109 a, a. e. two finger lengths

Targ. Ex. XXXI, 18; a. e.— Pl. אֶצְבְּעָתָא. Targ. Y. Gen. I, 7; a. fr. Targ. Ps. VIII, 4 אצבעותך. Ned. 49 b באצבעתיה with his fingers. Erub. 53 a we are כי א' בקירא לסברא (Ar. אוצבתא) as to reasoning like fingers on wax (hard to be impressed upon), ולשכחה וכ' but as to forgetfulness like fingers put in seed (leaving no trace), v. בִּזְרָא; a. fr.

I, 7 (16 a) you must not build … גרדום אצטדייא וכ' (Ms. M. אצטריבא, prob. אצטרינא, v. supra; in Gem. 18 b repeatedly אצטר', Mishn. Sifra Aḥare IX, 13. [Men. 103 b איסטריא של מלך royal amphitheatre(?), v. אסטרטיא.] [Tanḥ. B’resh. 2 אִסְטְרָטָאוֹת, Var. אִסְטְרָאוֹת theatres.] Ab. Zar. 18 b לא הלך לאיסטרטאות Ms. M. (ed. טַרְטְיָאוֹת q. v.; En Yak. תרט'). [For the vers. אִצְטַדְיָא v. s. v.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: arena; designação de teatro em forma derivada.
definicoes_originais: [אִיצְטַדִּין, v. preced. end] f. (prop. pl. of אצטרא, אסטרא, v. preced., used as sing.
notas_originais: ) same. B. Kam. IV, 4 (39 a) שור האיצטרין Ms. M. (ed. אצטדין, Ms. H. a. R. a. Mish. Nap. אסטדין, Y. ed. איסטדין) an ox of the arena (that killed a person). Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 7 היושב באסטרין וכ' Var. (ed. Zuck. איסטרטון, ed. איסטרין) he who attends the arena as a spectator is like a murderer (countenancing bloodshed); Y. ib. I, 40 a היושב באיצטדין (interchanging with תיאטרון theatrum). Pl. אִצְטְרִינִין &c. Ab. Zar. 18 b אין הולכין לא' מפני ש"ד Ms. M. (ed. לאצטדינין מפני מושב לצים …, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) you must not go to the arenas on account of bloodshed (ed. to theatres on account of ‘scorners’ seat’, Ps. I, 1). Ib. Ms. M. repeat. אִצְטָרִינָן, cmp. אֲבֵידָן. Tosef. l. c. 6 לאיצרטיונין (Var. לצטרדיונין, לצטריונין); 7 לאיצטריונין (Var. לטריונין, לצטריונין), cmp. טַרְטְיָאוֹת.

definicoes_originais: (צרך) travelling necessaries, provision.
notas_originais: Gen. R. s. 60. Koh. R. to XI, 1.
, v. אִסְטְרוֹפוֹמָטָא

verbetes.glosa_atual: corte; depressão; canteiro ou fileira agrícola.
definicoes_originais: (אצי, v. אַצְוָותָא) cut, depression, (agric.) bed as a measure, row.
notas_originais: — Pl. אִצְיָיתָא, אִצְיָאתָא, אוּצְ', אִיצְ'. B. Bath. 12 a תלת א' וכ' (Ms. M. איצ', Ms. F. איתייתא(?)) three rows containing twelve vine-trees each; (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). Ib. 41 b he encroached on his neighbor’s ground תרתי או' ed. (Mss. אי') two bed-widths

definicoes_originais: the joint which touches the rib, elbow (with or without יד).
notas_originais: Arakh. 19 b עד הא' up to the elbow.— Pl אַצִּילִים, constr. אַצִּילֵי. Zeb. 19 a top כנגד א' וכ' corresponding to the elbows (where the elbow in natural position touches the body). Y. Yoma V, 42 b bot.; a. fr.—(Chald.) Lev. R. s. 8, beg. ודין אצילים פריך some ed. (read אצילֵיה) and the other has his elbow (arm) broken.

verbetes.glosa_atual: esteira para embrulhar ou acondicionar tâmaras.
definicoes_originais: (v. צִיפָּא) matting used for bailing dates, cmp. חוֹתָל.
notas_originais: [Oth. opin: the flesh sticking to the stone of half-ripe dates.] Gitt. 89 a a woman was betrothed בא' דתוחלא (Ar. אצפא) with &c. (an object of no value).

definicoes_originais: (אצץ, cmp. אַצְוָותָא) a common bellied vessel.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 144 a אפי' א' דהרסנא Ms. (ed. ע') even a pot in which fish-hash is kept. Meg. 16 a א' דבית הכסא Ar. (ed. ע', Ms. O. עסיסא) night-chamber. [Targ. Esth. V, 1 ריעא עֲצוּצָא, read דְּעַ' … of the night-chamber.] Hebr. עָצִיץ.
, Targ. Koh. XII, 11 a gloss of אנצין, missing in ed. Buxt. a. oth.; v. אֲנַץ

definicoes_originais: (√צל, v. נצל) to protect, spare, exempt from taxes.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 55 a, v. אַנְדִּיסְקֵי.—[Bets. 14 a אצלי, v. צלי.]

definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Atsel, Atsal, mentioned I Chron. VIII, 37 sq.
notas_originais: ; IX, 43 sq. Pes. 62 b בין א' לא' וכ' (Ms. מן א' …, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note, for var. lect.) the explanation of the repetition of I Chr. VIII, 29 to 38, and IX, 35 to 44 and the verbal discrepancies between the two records would load four hundred camels with discussion; cmp. Rashi to I Chr. l. c.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ao lado; junto de; perto de.
definicoes_originais: by the side of, near, with.
notas_originais: B. Mets. V, 1 הרי אֶצְלִי בהן יין thou hast wine with me instead, i.e. I owe thee &c. Ib. 85 b א' מי אתה תקוע by whose side art thou lodged (in the world to come)?; Koh. R. to IX, 10; a. fr.

definicoes_originais: (צלח) success, prosperity.
notas_originais: Targ. Is. XXXIII, 20; a. e.
, v. צְלֵי

verbetes.glosa_atual: fecho; broche de vestimenta; faixa do joelho.
definicoes_originais: clasp or brooch for fastening dresses on going out, in Talm. knee-band; v. בִּירִית.
notas_originais: Sabb. 63 b בירית זו א' what the Mishnah calls birith is the Biblical etsadah; modified ibid. בירית תחת א' וכ' birith has the function of the etsadah (Rashi: birith around the knee serves the same purpose as etsadah on the shoulder, to save inconvenience in walking).

definicoes_originais: (אצף, v. יְצֵף) trouble, labor.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XVI, 23 בכל מן דא' לך (h. text עצב) in whatever is a trouble to thee.
, v. אֲצִיפָא

definicoes_originais: to lock up, hoard, gather ; cmp. גָּנַז.
notas_originais: B. Bath. 90 b אוֹצְרֵי פירות those who store up fruit (for speculation). Ib. אין אוֹצְרִין וכ'; Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV (V), 1 (אצר a. עצר used promiscuously) you must not hoard up (for speculation) such things as are necessaries of life; [correct אין א' דברים שיש … כגון יינות שמנים וסלתות ופירות]. Ib. לֶאֱצוֹר (Tosef. לאַצֵּר Pi.). Ib. לא יְאַצֵּר Pi. (Tosef. ולא יַעֲצוֹר, read לא; Var. לא יַאֲצִיר). Gen. R. s. 45 end (play on נבוכדרא̇צ̇ר̇) שאֲצָרָן וכ' he locked them up in the desert &c.—Y. Dem. VI, end, 26 a; Tosef. ib. VI, 4; Ab. Zar. 71 a אוֹצֵר (עוֹצֵר) government’s store-collector, commissary (apothecarius), or read אוֹצָר q. v.
, v. supra.

verbetes.glosa_atual: armazenar; reservar; em voz passiva, ser guardado.
definicoes_originais: to be stored up.
notas_originais: *Targ. O. Gen. XLI, 35 וייצרון, Var. ויוצרון, ויצרון). B. Bath. 90 b פוק אצר לי וכ' (prob. אַצַּר Pa.) go out and buy up for me for storage &c.
Targ. Is. XXIII, 18.

definicoes_originais: w. (preced.) אַצַּר פירי speculator in provision.
notas_originais: Yoma 83 a; B. Bath. 90 b

definicoes_originais: (preced.) contraction (h. עֹצֶר).
notas_originais: Bekh. 21 b א' חיותא contraction of the womb (and consequent destruction of the fœtus).

verbetes.glosa_atual: depósitos de vento; cavidades de concha perlífera.
definicoes_originais: , read אוֹצְרוֹת רוּחַ (v. אוֹצָר) stores of wind, name of the cavities in the pearl-shell in which the pearls are seated, and which contain a kali; v. אַשְׁלְגָא.
notas_originais: Y. Sabb. IX, end, 12 b top.
, v. אַקְוָוא

definicoes_originais: (קהי) bluntness or looseness of teeth.
notas_originais: Targ. Amos IV, 6 (h. text נקיון וכ') אקהיות שנין = perplexity. Cmp. אַקְוָוא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: leito para refeições dos nobres romanos.
definicoes_originais: , m. (accubitum, ἀκκούβιτον) dining couch of the Roman nobility of the imperial period in place of the older triclinium.
notas_originais: Lev. R. s. 7 מיסב על א' וכ' (Pesik. Eth. Korb. p. 61 a הקוביטין; Yalk. Num. 777 איק'; ib. Lev. 479 קוב', קנב'; ib. Ps. 791 הננ' &c., corr. acc.; Pesik. R. s. 16, p. 83 b ed. Fr. הקובטין) reclining on his accubitum.—לחם א', or ריפתא (ד)א' bread used at the meals of the nobility, fine bread. Targ. Y. II Gen. XL, 16 ריפתא קקבטון (read ריפתא דאקקובטון) bread of the nobles (h. text חרי). Pesik. R. l. c. p. 82 a (ref. to לחם הפחה Neh. V, 18) הקקבטין sub. לחם; Pesik. l. c. p. 59 a קקבטון (corr. acc.).
, B. Bath. 73 a bot. Ar., v. קוּפְיָא a. קוּבְנָאָה; cmp. אֲקוּנְבִּי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: o que embota os dentes; figuradamente, refutação e argumentos.
definicoes_originais: (קהי) what blunts or loosens the teeth, weakening ; fig. (v. Mekh. Bo 18, end) refutation, arguments.
notas_originais: Pl. אַקְוָותָא. Yeb. 110 b יתבי וקמקוו א' (Rashi Var. מקהו אַקְהָתָא) they were sitting and raising arguments. Cmp. אַקְהָיוּתָא.
, v. אִיקוֹנוֹמוֹס

verbetes.glosa_atual: cesto de junco; viveiro ou armadilha de pescador.
definicoes_originais: (deriv. of קנה, v. אקן)
reed-basket, used as a fisher’s cauf.
notas_originais: Kel. XII, 2; XXIII, 5.
v. אֲקַן
